registry_notes: Records whose implementation.state is registered describe the actual MCP surface in corel_operator/server.py.
Records whose implementation.state is planned are catalog entries only and are not exposed by the MCP server.
All current tools remain implemented_unverified until a reproducible X7 live-test report is recorded.
Since bridge 0.6.0 every tool returns tool-schema v1: a stable envelope whose data field contains the operation-specific result.
ID-001: common inspection/editing tools accept signed session object_reference values. StaticID-derived object_id strings remain inspection-only; no persistent cross-session identity is promised.

SAFE-001: opt-in external JSONL operation records cover all registered MCP tools and separate worker completion from caller return; operation_id is an optional envelope field. No client content or paths are logged.

SAFE-002: the dispatcher refuses concurrent/native busy follow-ups, cancels only pending timeouts, and quarantines late mutations or uncertain failure until exact-ID native reconciliation. Three metadata/recovery tools remain unverified against X7.
Typography: paragraph creation, bounded font catalog, whole-story styling and explicit native chain overflow are implemented_unverified; linked/fitted edits are refused.

Layout: native transform inspection, explicit-pivot rotation, mirroring, verified sibling ordering and measured distribution are implemented_unverified. Partial edits are quarantined by worker recovery.
